core_insight.why_different: It moves beyond current, often unreliable, standard measurements by applying a physics-constrained AI to solve for true hemodynamic states.
core_insight.if_wrong: Clinicians will continue to face fragmented and slow decision-making due to coupled and unreliable measurements, and ReadyRounds will fail to offer a significant improvement over existing diagnostic methods.
core_insight.source_excerpt: solving for the latent hemodynamic state — true flows and pressures — while respecting the laws of physics. Key deliverables include primary driver ranking (identifying which lesion most explains the clinical picture), a counterfactual simulator (predicting how fixing one valve will affect the severity of others), a consistency report (flagging measurements that contradict physical principles), and next-best-test guidance (identifying the specific measurement that would most reduce diagnostic uncertainty).
